meta.notes: Weights in pounds (as per Aventuria Armory English edition). BRW items use converted weights from Unzen (1 Unze = 25g ≈ 0.055 lbs). Prices in Silbertaler; BRW items with costs in Heller include cost_in_heller field (100 Heller = 10 Silbertaler = 1 Dukat). Structure Points (SP) indicate item durability. Focus rules bonuses noted where applicable.

equipment.name: Astrolabe
equipment.description: Complex instrument used by astrologists to determine calendar date, time of day, future position of constellations, and times of dawn and dusk. With SR 8 in Astronomy, grants +1 bonus to Astronomy checks. Allows calculating time to within 5 minutes.

equipment.name: Armillary Sphere
equipment.description: Spherical astrolabe variant showing orbits of stars and constellations. Easier to use than flat astrolabe, less precise. Successful Astronomy check increases SP by 1 (max 18). Requires SR 6 in Astronomy.

equipment.name: Backpack, Leather
equipment.description: Sturdy leather backpack ideal for carrying tools, provisions, and treasure. Can be worn over one or both shoulders. Carries up to 110 pounds of equipment.

equipment.name: Belt Pouch
equipment.description: Pouch that slides onto a belt with slits on the reverse side. Multiple compartments for trinkets, tools, vials, or small weapons. Retrieving an item from a belt pouch takes only 1 action.

equipment.name: Blacksmith's Hammer
equipment.description: Heavy hammer for forging hot steel. Can serve as improvised weapon. STR +1 on third partial Metalworking (Blacksmith) check.

equipment.name: Boltan Card Set (Cloth)
equipment.description: 72 elemental cards (Inrah deck) for the popular card game Boltan (Five Aces). Six elements (Fire, Water, Air, Ore, Humus, Ice) with seven numbered cards each plus five picture cards. Cloth version.

equipment.name: Boltan Card Set (Paper)
equipment.description: 72 elemental cards (Inrah deck) for Boltan. Paper version, more durable. Popular in Horasian Empire.

equipment.name: Breviary of the Twelvegods
equipment.description: Religious tome presenting the creed of the Twelvegods. Many editions exist. Contains descriptions of the twelve gods, demigods, prayers, and conduct guidelines. Grants +1 SGC bonus on second partial Religions check for general info on Alveran deities. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Candles (10)
equipment.description: 10 standard candles (beeswax, tallow, or sperm whale oil). Burning time 10 hours each. Candlelight reduces darkness visibility modifiers within 12-foot radius: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 3/6/9/12 foot radii.

equipment.name: Candle Clock
equipment.description: Specially marked candle that allows determining time of day to within 30 minutes. Functions like a regular candle otherwise.

equipment.name: Magic Candle
equipment.description: Special candle with secret ingredients for rituals. For invocations/banishments: +1 bonus on first partial check when correct number used (demons: 7, elementals: 6, ghosts: 5). Functions like a regular candle otherwise.

equipment.name: Cartographer's Tools
equipment.description: Ruler, divider, colored inks, and other tools for making accurate maps. DEX +1 on Artistic Ability (Drawing) checks when drawing maps.

equipment.name: Chalk
equipment.description: One piece sufficient for 20 pictures or large drawings like pentagrams. Used by scholars, miners, adventurers, and thieves for marking paths.

equipment.name: Magic Chalk
equipment.description: For drawing ritual circles and magical symbols. After drawing necessary symbols (demons: 7 drawings, elementals: 6, ghosts: 5), +1 bonus on first partial check to invoke or abjure the respective being.

equipment.name: Climbing Hooks (10)
equipment.description: Steel hook attachments for climbing walls and rock faces. When combined with climbing rope, grant +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Climbing Rope (per yard)
equipment.description: Hemp climbing rope typically 65+ feet long, strong enough for multiple adult humans. When combined with climbing hooks, grants +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Silk Rope (per yard)
equipment.description: Thinner, lighter, and more expensive than hemp rope but equally durable. Preferred by burglars and scholars. When combined with climbing hooks, grants +1 bonus on Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Cloak
equipment.description: Knee-length cloak protecting from rain and cold. Can function as blanket or improvised bag. Fighters sometimes wrap around arm for parrying. Intuition +1 bonus for Stealth (Conceal Item) if item can be hidden underneath.

equipment.name: Codex Albyricus
equipment.description: Body of law governing guild mages' rights and responsibilities. Seven volumes. Successful Law (Guild Law) check increases SP by 1/2/3 when possessing 1/3/7 usable volumes. Language: Bosparano / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Coin Bag
equipment.description: Circular leather piece with lace through holes. Holds up to 50 coins. DEX -1 penalty on Pick Pocket (Steal from Person) checks against target with coin bag.

equipment.name: Coin Pouch
equipment.description: Sophisticated coin container with multiple pockets for different coin types. Holds up to 20 coins. DEX and AGI both -1 on Pick Pocket checks against target with coin pouch.

equipment.name: Compass (South-Pointer)
equipment.description: Needle containing meteoritic iron that always points south. +1 bonus to Orientation checks. Allows calculating cardinal directions. Dwarves and Achaz have long valued this tool.

equipment.name: Copper Cauldron
equipment.description: Cooking cauldron of copper. Can serve as improvised weapon. STR +1 on second partial Cooking check.

equipment.name: Crowbar
equipment.description: Heavy iron pry bar for forcing open doors, crates, and locks. STR +1 on first partial Feat of Strength (Prying Open) check. Can serve as improvised weapon.

equipment.name: Encyclopaedia Magica
equipment.description: Reference work for magical knowledge. SGC +1 on Magical Lore checks. Language depends on edition.

equipment.name: Dice Set
equipment.description: Set of six-sided dice for various games. INT +1 on Gambling (Dice Games) checks.

equipment.name: Dressing Material (Bandages and Splints)
equipment.description: Basic bandages and splints for treating wounds. DEX +1 on first partial Treat Wounds check.

equipment.name: Flask
equipment.description: Container for liquids, holds about one quart. Can carry water, ale, or other beverages.

equipment.name: Flint and Steel
equipment.description: Fire-starting tools. DEX +1 on Craft (Firemaking) checks when using quality flint and steel.

equipment.name: Figurine of God or Goddess
equipment.description: Small devotional figure of a deity. Provides comfort and may grant minor bonuses to religious practices. Cost varies widely by deity, material, and quality.

equipment.name: Grapnel
equipment.description: Multi-pronged hook for throwing onto ledges, walls, or ship railings. When used as improvised chain weapon: see weapon tables. DEX +1 on Climbing checks when using grapnel with rope.

equipment.name: Gwen-Petryl Stone
equipment.description: Rare mineral that emits a faint light (turquoise or yellow-red glow). Found in temples of Efferd. Provides dim light within small radius. Cannot be extinguished.

equipment.name: Hand-axe or Hatchet
equipment.description: Utility axe for chopping wood. Can serve as improvised weapon: +1 DP vs plants (+2 vs wooden objects), but -2 DP vs armor PRO 3+. STR +1 on Woodcutting checks.

equipment.name: Helpful Primer for the Traveling Adept
equipment.german_name: Hilfreicher Ratgeber für den wandernden Adepten
equipment.description: Practical handbook for traveling mages. Covers survival, navigation, social customs, and more. SGC +1 on relevant knowledge checks. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Herbarium Kuslikum
equipment.description: Comprehensive reference for plant identification. +1 SP on successful Plant Lore checks. Language: Garethi / Kuslik Signs.

equipment.name: Hookah
equipment.description: Water pipe for smoking. Common in Tulamydian culture. Social item for negotiations and hospitality. CHA +1 on Seduce or Carousing checks in appropriate cultural contexts.

equipment.name: Hourglass
equipment.description: Sand-filled glass for measuring time intervals. Allows timing up to one hour. Useful for ritual timing and navigation.

equipment.name: Lantern
equipment.description: Oil-burning lantern. Burns 5 hours per dose of oil. Provides light in 30-foot radius. Wind-protected, unlike torches. Reduces darkness visibility modifiers: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 8/16/24/30 foot radii.

equipment.name: Lockpick
equipment.description: Tool for picking locks. DEX +1 on Pick Locks checks. For bit locks: grants bonus to one DEX partial check for Pick Locks (Bit Locks).

equipment.name: Mage Robe
equipment.description: Official garb of guild mages. Grants +1 bonus to Arcane Lore checks when worn in appropriate social contexts. Required by Codex Albyricus for guild mages during formal occasions.

equipment.name: Oil Lamp
equipment.description: Small oil-burning lamp. Burns 10 hours per dose of oil. Provides light in 15-foot radius. More fuel-efficient than lantern but smaller radius.

equipment.name: Padlock
equipment.description: Portable lock for securing containers, doors, and chains. Lock quality varies from poor to excellent, affecting Pick Locks difficulty.

equipment.name: Paper and Parchment
equipment.description: Writing material. One sheet of parchment (1 S) or paper. Essential for scholars, scribes, and mages recording magical formulas.

equipment.name: Perfume
equipment.description: Scented oil or liquid. CHA +1 on Seduce checks when wearing appropriate perfume. Quality varies widely from cheap to very expensive.

equipment.name: Phial
equipment.description: Small glass vial for holding potions, poisons, or alchemical substances. Typical container for healing potions and magical preparations.

equipment.name: Pocket Watch (Vinsalt Egg)
equipment.description: Mechanical clockwork timepiece known as a 'Vinsalt Egg'. Allows determining time to within 5 minutes. Luxury item for wealthy merchants and nobles.

equipment.name: Provisions (1 day)
equipment.description: One day's worth of food and drink (bread, dried meat, cheese, water). Costs 3 S per day in standard quality. Rations in wilderness cost double if purchased from merchants.

equipment.name: Quadrant
equipment.description: Navigational instrument for determining latitude and measuring angles to celestial bodies. +1 bonus to Navigation checks at sea. Requires clear sky.

equipment.name: Roast Skewer
equipment.description: Long iron skewer for roasting meat over fire. Can serve as improvised weapon: 1d6 DP from tip, cloth and leather armor -2 PRO vs skewer attacks. On successful parry: must make Feat of Strength or drop skewer.

equipment.name: Rolling Pin
equipment.description: Kitchen tool for rolling dough. Can serve as improvised weapon. Stunning Blow maneuver inflicts 1d3+1 DP. Breaks on confirmed botch.

equipment.name: Rope, Binding
equipment.description: Thin rope suitable for binding limbs, securing loads, and general utility. STR +1 on Feat of Strength (Dragging & Pulling) checks for tying.

equipment.name: Rope Ladder
equipment.description: Rope ladder with wooden rungs, typically 10 feet long. DEX +1 on Climbing checks when using rope ladder.

equipment.name: Shoulder Bag
equipment.description: Leather bag worn over shoulder. Holds up to 30 pounds. Quick access to stored items.

equipment.name: Sleeping Bag
equipment.description: Insulated sleeping bag providing protection against cold during rest. Reduces cold level by 1 while sleeping. Prevents certain penalties from poor sleep conditions.

equipment.name: Sickle
equipment.description: Curved blade for harvesting grain or cutting herbs. Can serve as improvised weapon (see weapons table). Useful tool for herbalists and farmers.

equipment.name: Snowshoes
equipment.description: Woven frame worn on feet to walk on snow. Reduces movement penalties in deep snow. Body Control (Balance) check +1 bonus when running in snow.

equipment.name: Soap
equipment.description: Soap for hygiene. Also useful for lubricating mechanisms. Can serve as improvised chain weapon in cloth tube (see weapon tables).

equipment.name: Spade
equipment.description: Digging tool. STR +1 on Earthwork checks. Can serve as improvised two-handed weapon.

equipment.name: Pickaxe
equipment.description: Mining and digging tool. STR +1 on Mining checks. Can serve as improvised two-handed weapon. Subtracts 1 PRO from armor PRO 4+ when used as weapon.

equipment.name: Telescope
equipment.description: Optical instrument for viewing distant objects. Reduces visibility modifiers for distant observation by 2. INT +1 on Perception (Observing) checks.

equipment.name: Tent (Small, 1-2 persons)
equipment.description: Small tent for 1-2 persons. Protects from rain and wind. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping inside in mild conditions.

equipment.name: Tent (Large, 4-6 persons)
equipment.description: Large tent for 4-6 persons. Full weather protection.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.description: Box containing flint, steel, and tinder for starting fires. Reliable fire-starting. DEX +1 on Craft (Firemaking) checks.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.description: Oil-soaked wooden torch. Burns 1 hour. Provides light in 20-foot radius. Can serve as improvised weapon. Reduces darkness visibility modifiers: -4/-3/-2/-1 for 5/10/15/20 foot radii.

equipment.name: Underwear
equipment.description: Standard underclothing: shirt, trousers, stockings. Basic protection against cold.

equipment.name: Vademecum of Combative Crafts
equipment.description: Comprehensive guide to various combat techniques and weapons. Grants +1 SP on successful Combat Techniques checks for specific weapons covered in the book.

equipment.name: Waterskin
equipment.description: Leather container for water. Holds about 2 quarts. Essential for travel. Prevents dehydration penalties.

equipment.name: Woolen Blanket
equipment.description: Warm woolen blanket. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping. Can serve as improvised cloak or rain protection.

equipment.name: Oil (Flask)
equipment.description: Flask of lamp oil. Fuels one lantern or oil lamp for 5-10 hours. Can be used as incendiary in extremis.

equipment.name: Writing Set (Quill, Ink, Paper)
equipment.description: Quill pen, inkwell, and several sheets of paper for writing. Essential for scholars and mages recording spells or research.

equipment.name: Healing Herbs
equipment.description: Bundle of medicinal herbs for basic wound treatment. DEX +1 on Treat Wounds checks when using quality herbs. One bundle sufficient for 3-5 treatments.

equipment.name: Mirror
equipment.description: Small polished metal or glass mirror. Useful for signaling, checking around corners, and defeating some supernatural creatures.

equipment.name: Lockpick Set
equipment.description: Complete set of lockpicks for various lock types. DEX +2 on Pick Locks checks. Illegal to carry without justification in most Aventurian cities.

equipment.name: Pack Mule (reference)
equipment.description: Pack animal for carrying equipment. Can carry up to 200 pounds. Standard transport animal for adventurers. Requires feed and care.

equipment.name: Riding Horse (reference)
equipment.description: Standard riding horse. Can be ridden at walking pace (60 feet/round) or gallop (240 feet/round). Requires stabling, feed, and care.

equipment.name: Fishing Hook with Line
equipment.description: Simple fishing hook attached to a line. Used for catching fish in rivers, lakes, and coastal waters. A basic survival tool for travelers.

equipment.name: Cup (Wooden)
equipment.description: Simple wooden drinking cup for everyday use. Standard eating and drinking vessel for travelers and common folk.

equipment.name: Eating Utensils (Cutlery Set)
equipment.description: A set of eating utensils: knife, spoon, and fork. Standard personal cutlery for travelers and adventurers who prefer not to eat with their hands.

equipment.name: Flute
equipment.description: A simple wind instrument for playing music. Used by bards, entertainers, and musically inclined travelers. Useful for the Music (Flute) talent.

equipment.name: Goose Quills (10) and Stylus
equipment.description: Ten goose-feather quill pens and a writing stylus. Essential writing tools for scholars and scribes. The quills need cutting with a penknife to maintain a sharp nib.

equipment.name: Hammer
equipment.description: A general-purpose hammer for driving nails, breaking stone, or basic construction. Can serve as an improvised weapon. Useful for a variety of Craft checks.

equipment.name: Hand Harp
equipment.description: A small portable harp played by bards and musicians. Produces a melodious sound and is a favored instrument in Aventurian courts and taverns. Used with the Music (Harp) talent.

equipment.name: Juggling Balls (3)
equipment.description: A set of three juggling balls for acrobatic entertainment. Used by performers and traveling entertainers. Can be used with the Body Control (Acrobatics) talent.

equipment.name: Comb
equipment.description: A simple comb for grooming hair. Made of wood, bone, or horn. A basic personal hygiene item carried by most travelers.

equipment.name: Magnifying Glass (Loupe)
equipment.description: A convex lens in a frame for magnifying small objects. Used by scholars, gem cutters, watchmakers, and alchemists. Grants +1 bonus to Perception (Searching) and Craft checks requiring fine detail work.

equipment.name: Sewing Kit
equipment.description: Needles, thread, and basic sewing supplies for mending clothing and gear. Useful for repairing torn clothing and leather equipment. Grants +1 to Craft (Tailoring) checks for minor repairs.

equipment.name: Iron Pan (30 cm)
equipment.description: A cast iron frying pan approximately 30 cm in diameter. Used for cooking over a campfire. Can serve as an improvised weapon. STR +1 on Cooking checks for pan-based preparations.

equipment.name: Scissors
equipment.description: A pair of metal scissors for cutting cloth, leather, and other materials. Used by tailors, barbers, and crafters. DEX +1 on Craft (Tailoring) checks.

equipment.name: Cosmetics Set (Assorted Makeup)
equipment.description: An assortment of cosmetic pigments, powders, and preparations for enhancing appearance or theatrical disguise. CHA +1 on Disguise checks and social Seduce checks in appropriate contexts.

equipment.name: Storm Lantern (Bullseye Lantern)
equipment.description: A wind-resistant lantern with a focusing lens that can project a directed beam or be shuttered completely. Burns oil. The bullseye lens focuses light into a beam up to 60 feet, useful for signaling. Can be shuttered instantly for stealth.

equipment.name: Tobacco Pipe
equipment.description: A pipe for smoking tobacco or other herbs. Common social item in taverns and during rest. Provides a calming effect during downtime. Popular with halflings and certain human cultures.

equipment.name: Cloth Bag
equipment.description: A simple cloth drawstring bag for carrying miscellaneous items. Lightweight and inexpensive general-purpose container. Can hold up to 10 pounds of loose goods.

equipment.name: Weapon Maintenance Kit
equipment.description: Whetstones, oil, rags, and other tools for maintaining weapons and keeping blades sharp. Regular use prevents the BF (Bruchfaktor/Breaking Factor) of weapons from degrading. Required for proper weapon care between adventures.

equipment.name: Weapon Care Set
equipment.description: Whetstones, oil, rags, and other tools for maintaining weapons and keeping blades sharp. Prevents weapon breakage and degradation. Alias for Weapon Maintenance Kit.

equipment.name: Rope (10 paces)
equipment.description: Hemp rope approximately 10 paces (roughly 25 feet) long. Strong enough to support the weight of a person. Used for climbing, binding, and securing loads.

equipment.name: Rope (10 paces) with Grapple Hook
equipment.description: A multi-pronged iron grapple hook on 10 paces of rope. Thrown onto ledges or walls for climbing. DEX +1 on Climbing checks. Can be used as an improvised thrown weapon.

equipment.name: Rucksack
equipment.description: A sturdy travelling backpack for carrying equipment, provisions, and supplies. Can hold up to 110 pounds of gear. Worn over one or both shoulders.

equipment.name: Magnifier (Magnifying Glass)
equipment.description: A convex lens in a frame for magnifying small objects. Used by scholars, gem cutters, alchemists, and investigators. Grants +1 bonus to Perception (Searching) and detail-work Craft checks.

equipment.name: Dice (3)
equipment.description: A set of three six-sided dice for games of chance and entertainment. INT +1 on Gambling (Dice Games) checks.

equipment.name: Wool Blanket
equipment.description: A warm woolen blanket for sleeping outdoors or in cold conditions. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping. Can serve as improvised cloak or rain protection.

equipment.name: Small Tent (1–2 persons)
equipment.description: A lightweight tent for 1–2 persons. Provides protection from rain and wind. Reduces cold level by 1 when sleeping inside.

equipment.name: Water Flask
equipment.description: A container for water and other liquids, holding about one quart. Essential for travel and preventing dehydration.

equipment.name: Flint
equipment.description: A piece of flint stone used with steel to strike sparks and start fires. The most common fire-starting material in Aventuria. Matches are unknown.

equipment.name: Flint, Steel and Tinder
equipment.description: Flint, a piece of steel, and dry tinder for starting fires. Takes at least 30 seconds to light a fire in the best conditions. The standard fire-starting kit in Aventuria. DEX +1 on Craft (Firemaking) checks.

equipment.name: Ink (Bottle)
equipment.description: A small bottle of writing ink. Sufficient for many pages of text. Required for writing with quills or as a supplement to the writing set.

equipment.name: Journal
equipment.description: A bound book of blank pages for recording notes, maps, and discoveries. Used by explorers, mages, and scholars. Provides organized pages for written records.

equipment.name: Notebook
equipment.description: A small bound notebook for quick notes, sketches, and memoranda. More portable than a full journal.

equipment.name: Writing Materials
equipment.description: Quill, ink, and several sheets of parchment or paper for writing. Essential for scholars and mages recording spells or research. Alias for Writing Set.

equipment.name: Leather Satchel
equipment.description: A sturdy leather satchel worn over the shoulder. Holds documents, books, and personal items. Preferred by scholars, merchants, and messengers.

equipment.name: Map Case
equipment.description: A cylindrical leather case for storing and protecting maps and scrolls from moisture and damage. Essential for navigators and explorers.

equipment.name: Rain Cloak (Waxed)
equipment.description: A waxed linen or oilskin cloak that repels rain. Keeps the wearer dry in wet conditions. Reduces the effects of cold and wet weather.

equipment.name: Travel Cloak
equipment.description: A sturdy, knee-length travelling cloak providing protection from rain and cold. Can double as a blanket or improvised bag. Intuition +1 on Stealth (Conceal Item) if item can be hidden underneath.

equipment.name: Boots
equipment.description: Sturdy leather boots suitable for travelling. Protect the feet from rough terrain and cold ground. Standard footwear for adventurers.

equipment.name: Herb Pouch
equipment.description: A small pouch containing a selection of common medicinal herbs and remedies. Useful for basic first aid and treating minor ailments on the road.

equipment.name: Healer's Bag with Supplies
equipment.description: A complete healer's bag containing bandages, splints, medicinal herbs, small blades for wound treatment, and other medical supplies. DEX +1 on Treat Wounds checks. Sufficient supplies for approximately 10 treatments.

equipment.name: Medical Instruments
equipment.description: A set of professional medical tools including probes, forceps, needles, and suturing thread for surgical procedures. DEX +1 on Treat Diseases and Treat Wounds checks requiring precision work.

equipment.name: Bandages
equipment.description: Clean cloth bandages for binding wounds and stopping bleeding. DEX +1 on first partial Treat Wounds check. Alias for Dressing Material.

equipment.name: Musical Instrument
equipment.description: A generic musical instrument suited to the character's background (lute, drum, flute, harp, etc.). Used with the Music talent for performance and cultural practices.

equipment.name: Quiver
equipment.description: A leather quiver for carrying arrows or bolts. Standard capacity of 20 arrows. Worn on the back or hip.

equipment.name: Hammock
equipment.description: A woven rope or cloth hammock for sleeping off the ground. Requires two trees or posts to hang from. Popular among sailors and jungle travellers.

equipment.name: Mess Kit
equipment.description: A compact set of eating and cooking vessels including a small pot, pan, cup, and utensils. Designed for field use and easy packing.

equipment.name: Bread Bag
equipment.description: A simple cloth or leather bag for carrying bread and other dry provisions. Standard soldier's and traveller's food pouch.

equipment.name: Wine Bag
equipment.description: A waxed or treated leather bag for carrying wine, water, or other liquids. Holds approximately 1 liter.

equipment.name: Wine Flask or Brandy Bottle
equipment.description: A glass or ceramic bottle containing wine or brandy. Used for social occasions, trade, and morale on the road.

equipment.name: Lockpicks
equipment.description: A complete set of lockpicks for various lock types. DEX +2 on Pick Locks checks. Illegal to carry without justification in most Aventurian cities. Alias for Lockpick Set.

equipment.name: Traveling Pack
equipment.description: A complete travel pack including a sturdy backpack, bedroll, and basic camping supplies. Holds up to 80 pounds of equipment.

equipment.name: Wilderness Survival Pack
equipment.description: A pack containing essential wilderness survival tools: rope, flint, hunting knife, fishing hook, bandages, and basic provisions. Grants +1 to Survival (Wilderness) checks when fully equipped.

equipment.name: Waterproof Message Satchel
equipment.description: A waxed leather satchel sealed against moisture, used by couriers and messengers to carry letters and documents. Keeps contents dry even in heavy rain.

equipment.name: Belt with Loops and Hooks
equipment.description: A sturdy belt fitted with multiple loops and iron hooks for hanging pouches, tools, and equipment. Standard adventurer's belt allowing quick access to carried items.

equipment.name: Work Props (Profession Tools)
equipment.description: A set of professional tools and props specific to a character's background or trade (e.g. a merchant's scales, a carpenter's tools, an actor's costume pieces). Grants +1 to relevant Craft or Social checks.

equipment.name: Tent
equipment.description: A canvas tent for camping in the field. Provides shelter from rain and wind, reducing cold level by 1 while sleeping inside. Fits 1–2 persons.

equipment.name: 10 Sheets Parchment or Journal
equipment.description: Ten sheets of parchment for writing, or a bound journal of equivalent capacity. Used by scholars, mages, and explorers to record notes and research.

equipment.name: 20 Sheets Paper
equipment.description: Twenty sheets of writing paper. Lighter and cheaper than parchment but less durable. Used by scribes, students, and those who write frequently.

equipment.name: Animal Trap Materials (3 traps)
equipment.description: Materials and pre-set components for constructing three small animal traps. Used for hunting and wilderness survival. Required for the Trapping talent.

equipment.name: Advance Pay (3 Silbertaler)
equipment.description: Three Silbertaler in advance pay, typically given to soldiers, mercenaries, or guild members at the start of employment. Represents starting coin rather than a physical item.

equipment.name: Boarding Hook or Boat Hook
equipment.description: A long pole with an iron hook at the end. Used by sailors for boarding vessels, pushing off from docks, and retrieving objects from the water. Can serve as an improvised two-handed weapon.

equipment.name: Bottle of Spirits or Herb Pouch
equipment.description: Either a bottle of strong spirits or a pouch of medicinal herbs, depending on the character's background. The spirits can also be used as antiseptic or fire accelerant.

equipment.name: Marked Cards or Loaded Dice
equipment.description: A deck of subtly marked playing cards or a set of weighted dice for cheating at games. INT +2 on Gambling checks when using these, but if discovered, severe social and legal consequences follow.

equipment.name: Chainmail (reference)
equipment.description: Interlocking iron rings providing solid protection. AR 3, EC 3. See Armor table for full statistics. Reference entry for starting equipment lists.

equipment.name: Long Chainmail (reference)
equipment.description: A full-length coat of interlocking iron rings reaching to the knees. AR 4, EC 4. See Armor table for full statistics. Reference entry for starting equipment lists.

equipment.name: Shield (reference)
equipment.description: A wooden or metal shield for deflecting blows. PA +3 to +5 depending on type. See Weapons table for full statistics. Reference entry for starting equipment lists.

equipment.name: Simple Wooden Shield (reference)
equipment.description: A basic wooden shield of wappenform construction, covered in leather. PA +3, INI -1. See Weapons table for full statistics. Reference entry for starting equipment lists.

equipment.name: Sword (reference)
equipment.description: A standard single-handed sword. AT 0/PA 0, 1d6+4 DP. See Weapons table for full statistics. Reference entry for starting equipment lists.

equipment.name: Concealed Dagger
equipment.description: A small dagger designed to be hidden on the person — in a boot, under a sleeve, or in a hidden sheath. -2 to Perception checks to detect. Counts as a dagger for combat purposes.

equipment.name: Hidden Sheath Knife
equipment.description: A small knife in a concealed sheath designed to be undetectable under clothing. Useful as a last-resort weapon and utility tool.

equipment.name: Warrior's License
equipment.description: An official document permitting the bearer to carry weapons in cities and settlements where open carry is otherwise restricted. Issued by local authorities, guilds, or noble houses.

equipment.name: Magic Staff with First Enchantment
equipment.description: A mage's personal staff that has received its first magical enchantment. Acts as a focus for spellcasting and a melee weapon. The first enchantment typically stores a small amount of astral energy.

equipment.name: Elvish Bow and Arrows
equipment.description: A finely crafted elvish longbow with a quiver of arrows. Superior quality to human-made bows. +1 AT on Bows talent checks when used. Arrows: 20.

equipment.name: Elvish Travel Clothing
equipment.description: Finely made elvish garments designed for forest travel: soft leather boots, woven tunic, and a light cloak. Provides +1 to Stealth checks in natural environments due to earthy, natural colours.

equipment.name: Fine Clothing
equipment.description: Well-tailored clothing of good quality fabric suitable for social occasions and meeting persons of standing. CHA +1 on social checks in appropriate settings.

equipment.name: Fine but Not Expensive Clothing
equipment.description: Presentable, well-kept clothing of respectable appearance without being ostentatiously expensive. Suitable for most social situations.

equipment.name: Fine Clothing (incl. Boots, Gloves, Cloak)
equipment.german_name: Feine Kleidung mit Stiefeln, Handschuhen und Umhang
equipment.description: A complete set of fine clothing including quality boots, gloves, and a cloak. Suitable for court appearances and formal occasions. CHA +1 on social checks in appropriate settings.

equipment.name: Good Clothing
equipment.description: Solid, respectable everyday clothing of good quality. Durable and presentable without being extravagant.

equipment.name: Colorful but Simple Clothing
equipment.description: Brightly colored but cheaply made clothing. Stands out in a crowd. Common among entertainers, traveling merchants, and people from southern Aventuria.

equipment.name: Dark Common Clothing
equipment.description: Plain, dark-colored everyday clothing. Inconspicuous and unremarkable. +1 to Stealth checks at night or in dark conditions.

equipment.name: Practical Clothing
equipment.description: Functional, hardwearing everyday clothing suited for an active lifestyle. Multiple pockets and durable stitching.

equipment.name: Sturdy Travel Clothes
equipment.description: Tough, weather-resistant travelling clothes designed for long journeys. Includes reinforced knees and elbows. Standard adventurer's wardrobe.

equipment.name: Sturdy Weatherproof Clothing
equipment.description: Heavy-duty clothing designed to resist wind and rain. Waxed seams and tight weave keep the wearer reasonably dry. Reduces weather-related penalties.

equipment.name: Sturdy Weatherproof Clothing or Uniform
equipment.description: Either sturdy weatherproof clothing or a military/organizational uniform depending on the character's background. Practical and durable for field use.

equipment.name: Plain Gray Travel Robe
equipment.description: A plain, unadorned gray robe suitable for inconspicuous travel. Conceals armor and weapons somewhat, and avoids drawing attention in cities and villages.

equipment.name: Robe with Arcane Symbols
equipment.description: A mage's robe embroidered with arcane symbols and sigils. Signals magical training and affiliation. CHA +1 when dealing with other mages and academics.

equipment.name: Tabard or Surcoat
equipment.description: A sleeveless over-garment bearing heraldic or organizational colors. Worn over armor to display allegiance. Required for official duties by many military and knightly orders.

equipment.name: Cloak with Unit Insignia
equipment.description: A travel cloak bearing the badge, color, or insignia of a military unit or organization. Grants recognition and authority within that unit's territory.

equipment.name: Feathered Hat
equipment.description: A wide-brimmed hat adorned with decorative feathers. Popular in the Middenrealm and among adventurers. CHA +1 in social situations — hard to ignore.

equipment.name: Tall Pointed Hat or Horned Cap
equipment.description: Either a tall conical mage's hat or a horned ceremonial cap, depending on the character's tradition. An iconic piece of headwear associated with arcane practitioners.

equipment.name: Dark Gloves
equipment.description: Close-fitting dark leather gloves. Leave no fingerprints and blend into shadow. +1 to Pick Pockets and Climbing checks.

equipment.name: Dark Hooded Cloak
equipment.description: A dark-colored cloak with a deep hood for concealing the face. +1 to Stealth and Disguise checks when hood is raised in low light.

equipment.name: Good Boots
equipment.description: High-quality leather boots that are both durable and comfortable for long travel. Better ankle support than standard boots; reduce fatigue penalties on long marches.

equipment.name: Waxed Cloak
equipment.description: A cloak treated with beeswax to repel water. Keeps the wearer dry in rain. Standard outdoor equipment for sailors, soldiers, and wilderness travelers.
